questions.prompt: Nintendo's top-selling Switch 2 games list is out tonight, and everyone's got a pick. You grab the Switch 2 — which game energy matches yours right now?

options.text: A slow, cozy one — I'm in no rush tonight.
The big adventure — straight into the thick of it.
Whatever my friends are playing — I'm joining in.
Honestly? I'm just staring at the menu, can't pick.

questions.prompt: The Ocarina of Time manga is everywhere tonight, and Hyrule's calling again. How are you stepping back in?

options.text: Quietly — just me and the story, lights low.
All in — my brain's already replaying the whole quest.
With a friend — I want someone to geek out with.
Flipping pages to wind down — I'm running on empty.

questions.prompt: The Packers are taking Fan Hall of Fame nominations, and tonight it's your big moment — they call your name. How does your acceptance speech go?

options.text: Short and sweet — I thank everyone and sit down fast.
I ham it up — this is my moment, I'm owning it.

I pull my people up on stage with me.

questions.prompt: Six near-perfect miniseries, eight episodes or less — tonight's a one-sitting binge on the couch. If someone handled the snacks and drinks, what would you want beside you?

options.text: A big bowl of popcorn — the crunch is half the show.
Something warm and slow — tea or cocoa, slow sips.
A full takeaway spread — tonight's a feast.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: A movie about the Mass Effect studio's closure is coming — the story of a world saying goodbye. What does that goodbye sound like to you tonight?

options.text: A quiet piano piece — soft, a little sad, still hopeful.
The game's own theme, on repeat — one more run through the galaxy.
Something loud and driving — the story fights on.
Silence — I just want the quiet after the credits.

questions.prompt: The manga got you thinking about Hyrule — the next hour is yours. How do you spend it back in Ocarina's world tonight?

options.text: Slow wandering — no quests, just the fields and the music.
Locked in — I'm finishing that dungeon tonight.
Calling a friend to trade memories and theories.
Honestly, I'll probably fall asleep mid-quest.
